review_process.parent: Codex parent; acquisition, direct source and visual figure inspection, integration and final source/diff review
review_process.independence: Correlated computational reviews using shared sources and context; no independent human or laboratory validation. Source objections override agreement.

adjudications.objection: Product-yield correlation and docking may be mistaken for direct donor-half measurements.
adjudications.resolution: Close that question at the missing experimental discriminant in the inspected main manuscript. Preserve the four-point correlation and preconstructed enamine as source interpretation; no pseudo-observation or model link.

adjudications.objection: A competing-product nondetection could imply improved target activity, zero side-product formation or infinite specificity.
adjudications.resolution: Retain WT 10.5 mM DHB/10.5 mM erythrulose and H473N 5.5 mM DHB with erythrulose nondetection. Only the target H473N/WT quotient is computed. Unknown detection threshold remains null; product routes and compound identities remain distinct.

adjudications.objection: The source gives lysate cofactor preparation concentrations, not final concentrations for the purified assay.
adjudications.resolution: Keep final purified-assay ThDP and MgCl2 null. Bind only the supported mixture, purified protein, temperature, duration, HPLC and triplicate conditions; preserve preparation values as separate context.

adjudications.objection: Two endpoint wrappers could be mistaken for independent experiments or microscopic fluxes.
adjudications.resolution: Both carry the same experiment identifier and triplicate-profile scope. The source net routes consume different compounds; no isotope mapping, microscopic flux, remaining-substrate calculation or elementary cause is inferred.

adjudications.objection: Error bars and source naming inconsistencies can invite invented precision or construct mapping.
adjudications.resolution: Keep graphical SD untranscribed and no propagated uncertainty/significance. Selected Results and Figure 3C establish source-named WT/H473N; exact sequence/preparation and unrelated library names are not resolved.

adjudications.objection: Yu2020 is a cited-reference followup, so a fresh batch label would discard inherited consumption.
adjudications.resolution: Continue two-substrate-lineages-2024-51831 with all prior 12 requests/741711 bytes and five new transports. Provisional label corrected before further acquisition; cumulative 17/22374147 stays within the original cap. Legacy human-TKT/POX accounting remains unchanged and incomplete.

adjudications.objection: Initial author and causal wording were inaccurate.
adjudications.resolution: Correct Haoran Yu identity; use nondetection instead of disappearance/suppression, distinguish source-assigned identities from standard-curve concentrations, and retain source-manuscript version.

blocked_operations: Measured pyruvate donor-half binding, adduct formation, decarboxylation or cleavage rate
Erythrulose ratio or infinite within-profile donor specificity from nondetection
Zero concentration/flux, statistical significance, equivalence or propagated uncertainty
Exact assayed sequence, mutant geometry or causal residue assignment
Transfer to 2024 TK variants, human TKT, other orthologs or MAL
Frozen-kernel/registry changes, independent validation or design-performance claim
remaining_limits: Accepted main manuscript and selected complete figures inspected. Publisher version, supplementary file, raw calibration/kinetics and independent enzyme preparations uninspected. Final publication-head review goes in the Git-local receipt.
